GPU-accelerated single-pass volumetric raycasting in Qt and OpenGL
The principles of raycasting Raycasting is a visualisation technique for volume rendering. In a nutshell, it consists of casting rays from the camera through each pixel of the viewport. Each ray draws a path through the volume, and intensity samples are collected along this path and used to render the pixel corresponding to the ray.
